alt: Mark Zuckerberg presenting the Meta Muse Charm — a small palm-sized device with a tiny screen — at the Meta Connect announcement event in September 2026
story: On September 23, 2026, Mark Zuckerberg unveiled the Muse Charm — a palm-sized keychain device with a tiny screen and fingerprint sensor for talking to Meta's Muse AI agent — which reviewers immediately compared to a 1990s Tamagotchi; the components aren't even finalised yet, and it won't ship until the holidays.
why_funny: Meta's answer to 'what replaces the smartphone?' is a keychain you press to ask your AI something, and Zuckerberg announced it at a splashy event while admitting the components aren't done yet.
